namespace App\Models;

use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Factories\HasFactory;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\SoftDeletes;

/**
 * @property int $id
 * @property string $title
 * @property \App\Enums\Status $status
 * @property \Illuminate\Support\Carbon|null $created_at
 * @property \Illuminate\Support\Carbon|null $updated_at
 * @property \Illuminate\Support\Carbon|null $deleted_at
 */
class Article extends Model

    use SoftDeletes;

        'status' => \App\Enums\Status::class,

}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Http\Controllers;

use App\Http\Controllers\Controller;
use App\Http\Requests\StoreArticleRequest;
use App\Http\Requests\UpdateArticleRequest;
use App\Models\Article;
use App\Http\Resources\ArticleResource;
use App\Services\ArticleService;
use App\DTO\ArticleDTO;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;

class ArticleController extends Controller
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly ArticleService $service
    ) {}

    /**
     * Display a listing of the resource.
     */
    public function index(Request $request)
    {
        Gate::authorize('viewAny', Article::class);

        $articles = $this->service->getAll($request->query());
        return ArticleResource::collection($articles);
    }

    /**
     * Store a newly created resource in storage.
     */
    public function store(StoreArticleRequest $request)
    {
        Gate::authorize('create', Article::class);

        $dto = ArticleDTO::fromRequest($request);
        $article = $this->service->create($dto);
        return new ArticleResource($article);
    }

    /**
     * Display the specified resource.
     */
    public function show(Article $article)
    {
        Gate::authorize('view', $article);

        return new ArticleResource($article);
    }

    /**
     * Update the specified resource in storage.
     */
    public function update(UpdateArticleRequest $request, Article $article)
    {
        Gate::authorize('update', $article);

        $dto = ArticleDTO::fromRequest($request);
        return new ArticleResource($this->service->update($article, $dto));
    }

    /**
     * Remove the specified resource from storage.
     */
    public function destroy(Article $article)
    {
        Gate::authorize('delete', $article);

        $this->service->delete($article);
        return response()->noContent();
    }

    /**
     * Restore the specified soft-deleted resource.
     */
    public function restore(Article $article)
    {
        Gate::authorize('restore', $article);

        return new ArticleResource($this->service->restore($article));
    }

    /**
     * Permanently delete the specified resource.
     */
    public function forceDelete(Article $article)
    {
        Gate::authorize('forceDelete', $article);

        $this->service->forceDelete($article);
        return response()->noContent();
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\Article;
use App\DTO\ArticleDTO;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Collection;

class ArticleService
{
    public function getAll(array $filters = []): Collection
    {
        $query = Article::query();

        foreach ($filters as $field => $value) {
            if (in_array($field, (new Article())->getFillable(), true)) {
                $query->where($field, $value);
            }
        }

        return $query->get();
    }

    public function create(ArticleDTO $dto): Article
    {
        return Article::create($dto->toArray());
    }

    public function find(int|string $id): Article
    {
        return Article::findOrFail($id);
    }

    public function update(Article $article, ArticleDTO $dto): Article
    {
        $article->update($dto->toArray());
        return $article->fresh();
    }

    public function delete(Article $article): bool
    {
        return $article->delete();
    }

    public function restore(Article $article): Article
    {
        $article->restore();
        return $article;
    }

    public function forceDelete(Article $article): bool
    {
        return $article->forceDelete();
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\DTO;

use App\Http\Requests\StoreArticleRequest;
use App\Http\Requests\UpdateArticleRequest;

readonly class ArticleDTO
{
    /**
     * @param  array<int, string>|null  $provided
     */
    public function __construct(
        public ?string $title = null,
        public ?string $status = null,
        private ?array $provided = null
    ) {}

    public static function fromRequest(StoreArticleRequest|UpdateArticleRequest $request): self
    {
        $data = $request->validated();

        return new self(
            title: $data['title'] ?? null,
            status: $data['status'] ?? null,
            provided: array_keys($data)
        );
    }

    /**
     * The fields the request sent, or every property when built by hand.
     *
     * @return array<string, mixed>
     */
    public function toArray(): array
    {
        $values = get_object_vars($this);
        unset($values['provided']);

        return $this->provided === null ? $values : array_intersect_key($values, array_flip($this->provided));
    }
}

namespace Tests\Feature;

use App\Models\Article;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Illuminate\Support\Arr;
use Tests\TestCase;

class ArticleControllerTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    public function test_can_list_articles(): void
    {
        Article::factory()->count(3)->create();

        $response = $this->getJson('/api/articles');

        $response->assertStatus(200)
            ->assertJsonCount(3, 'data');
    }

    public function test_can_create_article(): void
    {
        $data = [
            'title' => 'test_title',
            'status' => 'draft',
        ];

        $response = $this->postJson('/api/articles', $data);

        $response->assertStatus(201);
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('articles', [
                    'title' => 'test_title',
                ]);
    }

    public function test_can_show_article(): void
    {
        $article = Article::factory()->create();

        $response = $this->getJson("/api/articles/{$article->getKey()}");

        $response->assertStatus(200)
            ->assertJsonFragment(['id' => $article->getKey()]);
    }

    public function test_can_update_article(): void
    {
        $article = Article::factory()->create();
        $data = [
            'title' => 'test_title',
            'status' => 'draft',
        ];

        $response = $this->putJson("/api/articles/{$article->getKey()}", $data);

        $response->assertStatus(200);
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('articles', [
                    'title' => 'test_title',
                ]);
    }

    public function test_can_patch_article(): void
    {
        $article = Article::factory()->create()->fresh();

        $response = $this->patchJson("/api/articles/{$article->getKey()}", ['title' => 'test_title']);

        $response->assertStatus(200);
        $this->assertDatabaseHas('articles', ['id' => $article->getKey(), 'title' => 'test_title']);
        $this->assertSame(
            Arr::except($article->getAttributes(), ['title', 'updated_at']),
            Arr::except($article->fresh()->getAttributes(), ['title', 'updated_at'])
        );
    }

    public function test_can_delete_article(): void
    {
        $article = Article::factory()->create();

        $response = $this->deleteJson("/api/articles/{$article->getKey()}");

        $response->assertStatus(204);
        $this->assertSoftDeleted('articles', ['id' => $article->getKey()]);
    }

    public function test_can_restore_article(): void
    {
        $article = Article::factory()->create();
        $article->delete();

        $response = $this->postJson("/api/articles/{$article->getKey()}/restore");

        $response->assertStatus(200);
        $this->assertNotSoftDeleted('articles', ['id' => $article->getKey()]);
    }

    public function test_can_force_delete_article(): void
    {
        $article = Article::factory()->create();
        $article->delete();

        $response = $this->deleteJson("/api/articles/{$article->getKey()}/force-delete");

        $response->assertStatus(204);
        $this->assertDatabaseMissing('articles', ['id' => $article->getKey()]);
    }

    public function test_create_article_validates_required_fields(): void
    {
        $response = $this->postJson('/api/articles', []);

        $response->assertStatus(422);
    }
}

<?php

namespace Tests\Unit;

use App\Models\Article;
use App\Services\ArticleService;
use App\DTO\ArticleDTO;
use Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase;
use Tests\TestCase;

class ArticleServiceTest extends TestCase
{
    use RefreshDatabase;

    private ArticleService $service;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        $this->service = new ArticleService();
    }

    public function test_can_get_all_articles(): void
    {
        Article::factory()->count(5)->create();

        $result = $this->service->getAll();

        $this->assertCount(5, $result);
    }

    public function test_can_filter_articles(): void
    {
        Article::factory()->count(3)->create();

        $result = $this->service->getAll([]);

        $this->assertCount(3, $result);
    }

    public function test_can_create_article(): void
    {
        $dto = new ArticleDTO(
            title: 'test_title',
            status: 'draft',
        );

        $article = $this->service->create($dto);

        $this->assertInstanceOf(Article::class, $article);
        $this->assertDatabaseCount('articles', 1);
    }

    public function test_can_find_article(): void
    {
        $article = Article::factory()->create();

        $found = $this->service->find($article->getKey());

        $this->assertEquals($article->getKey(), $found->getKey());
    }

    public function test_can_update_article(): void
    {
        $article = Article::factory()->create();
        $dto = new ArticleDTO(
            title: 'test_title',
            status: 'draft',
        );

        $updated = $this->service->update($article, $dto);

        $this->assertInstanceOf(Article::class, $updated);
    }

    public function test_can_delete_article(): void
    {
        $article = Article::factory()->create();

        $result = $this->service->delete($article);

        $this->assertTrue($result);
        $this->assertSoftDeleted('articles', ['id' => $article->getKey()]);
    }
}
